description: Solves the physics again on a finer mesh (element size times `factor`; the project is not changed) and compares every eigenvalue, value and scalar with the present result. With `tolerance` each row says pass or fail and `converged` summarises. Use it before quoting a number: a mode index that moves by more than your tolerance is not converged.
name: convergence_check

factor.description: finer/present element size, between 0 and 1, default 0.6

tolerance.description: largest accepted relative difference, e.g. 1e-3; omit to only report
